notes: Harvest at OD600 = 2 in M9 glycerol: no phase. Hosts SDT507 (gly2 rhaBADM KO) and SDT492 (gly2) both treated as the reference genotype of their arms; their 'Control' plasmid samples are controls. 'Control, delayed sampling' is_control left out (different sampling time, not specified). 'T7 control' (pSD78 + pSD208) set is_control true, genotype_class left out (pSD78 presumably carries the T7 system, not stated). MBP expression: genotype_class left out (MBP may be native malE or fused). Inducer not stated anywhere -> inducer_added left out. Choline 5 mM labelled other_chemical (adapted). Plasmid antibiotics not treatments.
